name: Astro Penguin
summary:
MARS IS MELTING! 
Its icy poles dissolve into vast oceans, and
eerie green light floods the skies.

Braving the unknown, penguin astronauts
CAPTAIN PEBBLESWORTH and MAJOR BEEKMAN
embark on a perilous mission to uncover the truth…

Astro Penguin is an experimental VR platformer. Penguin astronauts have a range of locomotion abilities. They can slide, swim, glide, flap, carve, surf, rocket, grind, (stay tuned for more!). Explore Mars with realistic-feeling movement: feel the wind on your wings.
